title: fix(spec)!: defineConnector() refuses a top-level key the connector does not declare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RavNfuxRRXtHCcMEJuJFjH)_
Fixes #28738

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the published skills' connector recipes (`skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md`) author declared keys only and say nothing about the helper's key posture, so no skill text turns false.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`defineConnector()` 改为解析闭合的连接器形状;写了未声明的顶层键会当场报错并点名,附处方(凭据类键指向 `auth.credentialRef`,提供方设置指向 `providerConfig`,`timeout` 指向 `requestTimeoutMs`)。
- 为什么改:它原来解析开放的 `ConnectorSchema`,先把未声明的键悄悄丢掉,`defineStack` 等闭合门再也看不到,作者放错位置的设置(比如把 `timeout` 写在根上)无声丢失。现在它和其它所有连接器入口一样响亮拒收。
- 风险与回滚:属于收窄(破坏性)。仓内 7 处调用和文档示例都只写已声明键,不受影响;第三方若在 `defineConnector` 里写了未声明键,加载时会报错。插件给 `registerConnector` 的定义不变。回滚只需把 `defineConnector` 函数体改回 `ConnectorSchema.parse`。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts` 的 `DefineConnectorSchema` 与 `defineConnector` 函数体;`connector-entry-undeclared-keys.test.ts` 新增的一组测试;`.changeset/harden-connector-undeclared-keys.md` 改动的那一句。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-entry-undeclared-keys.test.ts`,应看到 24 条全过。
- 需要你做的:在本 PR 上书面确认对 #28688 待发 changeset 那一句的更正(Check Changeset 因此保持红,它不是必需检查,不挡合并)。

## What changes

- `defineConnector()` (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/spec/integration`) parses a module-private `DefineConnectorSchema`: the closed carrier `DeclarativeConnectorEntryBaseSchema` behind the same retired-default residue stage (`CONNECTOR_RETIRED_KEY_RESIDUE`) that `ConnectorSchema` and `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` use. An undeclared top-level key now throws a `ZodError` with one `unrecognized_keys` issue at the root, carrying the entry's own message, aliases and guidance. The signature is unchanged: input `z.input` of `ConnectorSchema`, return `ConnectorParsed`; `check:api-surface` and the rest of `check:generated` needed no regeneration.
- `ConnectorSchema` (the def a plugin hands to `registerConnector`) keeps its open posture; option C of the card is not taken.
- The helper does not apply the stack-only ADR-0097 / ADR-0143 refinements of `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` (no inline `authentication`, `providerConfig` / `auth` need a `provider`, no `actions` on a provider-bound instance, the oauth2 / signed instance rules). Every stack door still applies them to the value the helper returns. See the Acceptance notes for why, and the measured fact that the two choices agree on every in-repo caller.
- The ADR-0087 entry `connector-entry-undeclared-key-refused` (landed with #28688, not yet released) now names `defineConnector()` in its surface and reason. This PR's changeset disposes as `not-required (already-registered connector-entry-undeclared-key-refused)`.
- Docblocks in `connector.zod.ts` and the `integration/` row of `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md` stop saying the helper parses the open shape.

### A pending release note this PR corrects

`.changeset/harden-connector-undeclared-keys.md` (from #28688, still pending) said: "`ConnectorSchema` — the def a plugin hands to `registerConnector`, and the shape `defineConnector()` parses — keeps its posture." This PR makes the `defineConnector()` half false, so the clause is removed and the sentence now reads "`ConnectorSchema` — the def a plugin hands to `registerConnector` — keeps its posture." `check-empty-changeset` refuses this edit by design (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class), so **Check Changeset stays red** until a maintainer confirms the correction here in writing. It is not a required context.

## Tests

New `describe` block in `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-entry-undeclared-keys.test.ts` (12 cases; the file had 12): for an instance and a descriptor, each refusal pinned by `code`, `path` and `keys` on the thrown `ZodError`, the value never echoed; `timeout` → `requestTimeoutMs` with the declared spelling as control; the credentialRef and `providerConfig` guidance; the helper's issue equal to the stack door's issue on the same entry; residue (`status: 'inactive'`) and the ADR-0010 envelope still accepted; and a pin that the helper applies no stack-only refinement. Forced test edits: none; no existing test changed.

Ablation at 4185e6a9 (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, body put back to `ConnectorSchema.parse(config)`, anchor 1 → 0, restored blob equal to HEAD): **7 failed | 17 passed (24)**. The 7 are exactly the refusal cases; controls, residue, envelope and the no-refinement pin pass on both sides, as they should.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why the closed base, not the full entry schema.** The card's option B says the helper "parses the closed twin". The full `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema` would also refuse an inline non-`none` `authentication` and the other stack-only rules at the helper. That would break any plugin code that builds a `registerConnector` def through `defineConnector`, which is the code-to-code break option C was kept out of this card for. Measured: all 7 in-repo callers and all 5 `os:check` blocks in `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` give the same verdict under either choice, so the choice changes nothing in this repo. It is listed as an open question for the seat.
- The helper's ZodError message is the strict entry's message, because the parse runs through the same `strictObject` carrier. It says "this connector entry", which fits the documented use.
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx` names `defineConnector` among the doors that refuse retired keys. That is release-owned and still true; not touched.

- `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. The new changeset reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing+metadata-protocol-narrowed]`, disposition `not-required (already-registered)`.
- Local-only `pnpm check:dev-prereqs`: exit 1. It reads this host's build state (35 `ui/` packages with no dist), not this diff. Reported, not acted on.

</details>
